summary: Android app for collecting donations from donors for animal welfare organizations.
architectural_notes: Android-native app (Java/Kotlin) targeting animal welfare donation collection
Requires secure payment gateway integration (e.g., Stripe or Razorpay)
imageRequirements:
## Required Images
- Circular app logo with a warm amber paw print icon centered on a creamy white background, clean and friendly style (pawfund-logo.dim_256x256.png)
- Wide hero banner with illustrated warm savanna/shelter scene featuring silhouettes of happy animals (dog, cat, bird) in golden hour lighting with soft green foliage, earthy amber and soft green color palette (pawfund-hero.dim_1200x400.png)

existing_features.title: Design and apply a warm, compassionate visual theme throughout the app — earthy tones (warm ambers, soft greens, creamy whites), friendly rounded typography, card-based layout with gentle shadows, and nature/animal-inspired accent details. Apply consistently across all pages.

Implement donor registration and profile management. Donors can sign up and log in using Internet Identity. Profile includes display name, profile picture (URL), contact email, and total lifetime donations.

Implement animal welfare campaign/cause listings. Each campaign has a title, description, target animal/cause category (e.g., stray dogs, wildlife rescue, shelter cats), cover image URL, fundraising goal, amount raised, start date, end date, and active/completed status.

Implement donation submission for campaigns. Donors can make a one-time donation of a chosen amount to any active campaign. Record each donation with donor ID, campaign ID, amount (in USD), timestamp, and a transaction reference ID. Update the campaign's total raised amount upon successful donation.

Implement recurring donation support. Donors can opt into a monthly recurring donation when submitting. Recurring donations are stored with a frequency field (monthly) and a next-due date. Display active recurring donations on the donor's profile page with the option to cancel.

Implement a donation history page for logged-in donors. Display a chronological list of all past donations made by the donor, showing campaign name, amount, date, and a downloadable/viewable receipt stub with a unique transaction reference.

Implement a campaign progress tracking view. Each campaign detail page shows a visual progress bar indicating percentage of fundraising goal reached, total donors count, days remaining (if end date is set), and a list of recent donors (by display name or 'Anonymous').

Render the generated hero banner and app logo as static assets. Use 'pawfund-logo.dim_256x256.png' in the app header/navbar and 'pawfund-hero.dim_1200x400.png' on the home page above the campaign listings.

new_feature_requests.summary: Browse and support animal welfare campaigns/causes
Donation history and receipts for donors
Campaign/cause listing with details and progress tracking
